_comment: Allow-list of segments the paper ledger may log as a CANDIDATE (staked).
A market not listed here is never a candidate; it can still be logged as a
shadow with no stake so it can be evaluated before anyone bets on it.
edge_threshold_points is net of Kalshi's fee (paper/fees.py) and is
PRE-STATED, not tuned: 4.0 points, from the brief. Any sweep of this number
on the data it is applied to belongs in an exploratory section, not here.
gate.min_settled is a floor, not a preference. services/paper/tests/
test_gate.py fails if it is ever lowered below 300.

segments.note: NFL home/away moneyline. Kalshi prices from KXNFLGAME (collector PR #83); model_p from NFL's public snapshot (home_win_prob).
NFL over/under total. Kalshi prices from KXNFLTOTAL; model_p = over_prob from the snapshot (for the book's line, not Kalshi's — an approximation).
PL home / draw / away. Kalshi prices from KXEPLGAME (collector PR #80); model_p from PL's public snapshot (home_win.prob, draw.prob, away_win.prob).
PL total goals. Kalshi prices from KXEPLTOTAL; model_p = P(over N.5 goals) from PL's published score_grid, evaluated at each rung's own line.
PL both teams to score. Kalshi prices from KXEPLBTTS; model_p = the snapshot's published btts_yes_prob.
From the brief. Blocked today: NFL publishes no per-prop probability (the API strips quantiles), so nothing can be logged until PR 1b.
From the brief. Same blocker as nfl:receptions.
NBA moneyline. Kalshi prices from KXNBAGAME; model_p = home win probability from the props table (home_win_prob), served per game from the tracking database.
NBA spread. Kalshi prices from KXNBASPREAD; model_p = P(home covers spread) = P(predicted_margin > spread) from predicted_margin and the margin sigma, per game from the tracking database.
NBA total. Kalshi prices from KXNBATOTAL; model_p = P(over total) = P(total > line) from predicted_total and the total sigma, per game from the tracking database.
NFL publishes per-game win probability, but NFL's collector fetches only four player-prop series and no KXNFLGAME ladder, so there is no price to pair it with.
Same as nfl:moneyline: probability yes, KXNFLTOTAL price no.
CFB home/away moneyline. Kalshi prices from KXNCAAFGAME; model_p = home_win_prob / away_win_prob from the CFB snapshot's weeks.
CFB total points. Kalshi prices from KXNCAAFTOTAL; model_p = P(over N.5 points) from predicted_total and total_sigma, at each rung's own line.

CFB spread. Kalshi prices from KXNCAAFSPREAD, whose ladder is a MARGIN market ('<Team> wins by over N.5 points'); model_p = P(that team's margin > N.5) from predicted_margin and sigma, at each rung's own line.
